title: pm-eng-1on1-prep-riley-chen
content:
Goal for this 1:1: quick status sync + unblock engineering decisions for API/Console/Dedicated/Private workstreams. Leave with 3 concrete action items and any needed escalations.

Agenda drafts (30m):
- 5m quick wins / highlights
  - Canary rollout of v2 batching landed on prod canary (metrics look ok) — Jordan to confirm infra logs are green
  - Support cost drop when v2 quantization used in Dedicated tests (~12% lower tokens cost)
- 10m blockers / decisions (priority order)
  1) API throttling policy change (rate limit per key vs per-org) — need final decision for next release.
     - Context: product asks per-org quota to avoid noisy single-user keys blowing budget (see PROD-310). Backend supports both; console UX needs small change.
     - Tradeoffs: per-key simpler for enforcement; per-org better for enterprise customers. Affects billing reconciliation for 3rd-party proxies.
     - My leaning: per-org default with opt-out to per-key for small teams. Ask: is implementation/ops complexity acceptable?
  2) Console rollout for Dedicated customers (feature parity vs MVP)
     - Important bits: model pinning UI, route/region selector, billing overview. MVP can defer advanced rollout controls.
     - Ask: what is realistic for Q2 release with current SRE bandwidth?
  3) Private deployment onboarding docs & automation gaps
     - Several customers (pilot) hit manual steps around KMS integration and local logging. Need checklist + orchestration tasks.
     - Ask: can solutions eng own a short-term runbook while infra automates next quarter?
- 10m metrics / health signals to watch
  - API p99 latency (text-gen): 210ms (canary) / 260ms prod — target <220ms p99 for hosted tier.
  - Error rate spike on model_fallback path during last outage (see ENG-842) — need deeper root cause if recurrence.
  - Cost per 1k tokens for standard models: $0.95 -> target reduction via batching/quantization suggestions.
- 5m action items / next steps (capture owners + due dates)

Notes / talking points to raise
- Clarify rollout strategy: we should gate per-org rate limit behind enterprise flag; product will own the UX, eng will own enforcement and migration strategy. Need a migration plan for existing keys.
- For Dedicated console, propose incremental rollout: phase 1 = core controls (model pinning, capacity view, basic rollouts), phase 2 = advanced rollout policies + observability deep-dive. This buys time for SRE.
- Private: manual runbook acceptable short-term but we must publish a "private quickstart" by next customer pilot (target 2026-03-20).

Open questions I want Jordan to answer
- Effort estimate for adding per-org quota enforcement + migration script (ballpark days/weeks)?
- Does SRE have capacity to support Dedicated console phase 1 in current sprint cycle, or do we push to next?
- Root cause for model_fallback error spike: is the fallback path still rate-limited differently? Any easy mitigations?

Action items (explicit)
- Jordan: provide rough ETA for per-org quota enforcement + migration plan; include rollback strategy. Due: 2026-03-10.
- Riley (me): draft migration UX copy + rollout comms for customers (email + console notice). Due: 2026-03-06.
- Alicia (solutions eng): create private deployment "quickstart" runbook (markdown) with KMS steps, logging checklist, known gotchas. Due: 2026-03-20.
- Jordan + Infra: short postmortem on ENG-842 fallback spike — root cause hypothesis + mitigation by next week (2026-03-11).

Follow-ups I will prepare after the 1:1
- One-pager for leadership summarizing quota decision + impact (think billing reconciliation, security).
- Updated product spec for Dedicated console phase 1 with prioritized feature list and SRE requirements.
- Put tickets in backlog for private automation: KMS integration task, logging orchestration task, runbook maintenance.

Back-of-envelope numbers to cite
- Current hosted API monthly spend (approx): $120k; top 5 customers ~45% of spend.
- Expected cost savings from batching/quantization adoption for Dedicated customers: 8–15% depending on sequence lengths.
- SLA target for Dedicated: 99.9% uptime monthly; ensure console features don't add control-plane risk.

Misc notes / quick scratches
- Remember to ask about hiring priority for infra SDE role (we promised a headcount last quarter, status?).
- Bring up cross-team doc link: confluence page for "api-rate-limit-design" (link in artifacts).
- Check whether billing team needs data schema change for per-org quotas (possible refactor).

Tone for the meeting
- Collaborative, solve-for-minimum-viable-safety for production changes. Want concrete owners and dates.
- Escalate only if SRE can't support phase 1 timing.

Recent context (last 2 weeks)
- Ran internal eval showing v2 quantization performs well on internal test corpus (see GH PR 456).
- A pilot enterprise customer asked explicitly for per-org quotas + dedicated console access (this is driving priority).

End of prep notes.

Quick checklist before join:
- Slack Jordan to confirm 15m early if any hot items
- Attach ENG-842 and PROD-310 to the meeting invite
- Bring the migration UX draft (Riley)
summary: PM-Eng 1:1 prep for Riley Chen with Jordan Khan; focus on quota policy, Dedicated console rollout, private onboarding runbook; concrete actions and due dates captured.
